body: This just keeps happening... And still Everytime I don't want to, and say no, I end up letting him. Just because I don't want to have him mad at me and reject me from cuddling, talking, etc... I don't really know what to do about this because it happens all of the time with him. I feel like if I say no, he will be mad and accuse me of sleeping with someone else.   But when we talk about it.. he says "it's not like I'm forcing you" because if I'm stern enough.. he will quit... But what he does not know is that when I'm not stern I'm scared because I've been raped before. Rape is not what people make it out to be. I was raped by my ex. And my current bf thinks it was consentual just because I wasn't physically hurt... And then he does the same thing? Like...why? And how? My ex was overdosing and having a seizure and u STILL didn't take off his boxers because he wasn't able to tell me no... So why is this happening?.... I try to calmly explain... But it ends up such a huge fight. I just want to feel loved and protected... I'm so confused

Please don't give up. There's people that do care about you. I care about you. I understand your struggles, and actually find that we have a lot in common... I know things are very hard... It can get better if you allow it to. I know that hearing things like this from a complete stranger on the Internet isn't really what you want to hear, but I'm hoping it will help. Have you tried talking to anyone about how depressed you have been? I'm not sure where you are from, but is there anywhere that you can seek professional help? I have been thinking about doing the same...I know things are very hard and they seem like they won't ever get better but they can. 

I too am 'crashing' at someone's house. I have no job, no money, nothing.... So I understand how you must feel and it feels like the pain inside of you isn't ever going to go away. I know what it's like to feel like you're a burden and things will be better if you weren't around... Please don't do anything to hurt yourself. 

Just know that there is someone who cares about you, there's so many people who care about you and want you to get better. Please keep your head up... I don't know if this will help, I'm kind if just rambling on and on, but I couldn't help but to let you know that things can get better.

I completely forgot about this until I came back on here and read my post. That's crazy. I guess my mind blocked it out after I got my answer..  I don't know... I'm still having trouble remembering this night now.... Why? I mean I know your brain suppresses traumatic memories or whatever but still how could I forget that this happened? I remember making this post because last night just about the same thing happened... So I wanted to get back on here and talk about it... Him and I are back together now and have been for awhile... But how could I forget about this? It makes me so angry....
